# Genesis Apocryphon Column 3 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Genesis Apocryphon Column 3 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 3:1 — "everything" vs "the whole matter"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "I-told him everything" | Literal rendering of kolla |
| LOGOS | "I told him everything" | Standard formal |
| PNEUMA | "told him the whole matter" | Dynamic paraphrase specifying content |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS "I told him everything." PNEUMA's "the whole matter" narrows kolla unnecessarily.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 3:8 — "lot is assigned" vs "portion is cast" vs "destiny is shared"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "his lot is assigned" | Literal rendering |
| LOGOS | "his portion is cast" | Formal equivalent with lot-casting imagery |
| PNEUMA | "his destiny is shared" | Dynamic interpretation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "his portion is cast." Preserves the lot-casting imagery of the Aramaic while remaining readable.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 3:9 — "share everything" vs "hold nothing back"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "they share everything with him" | Positive literal statement |
| LOGOS | "they share all things with him" | Formal with "all things" |
| PNEUMA | "they hold nothing back from him" | Negative dynamic restatement |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "they share all things with him." The positive statement is closer to the Aramaic; PNEUMA's negative reformulation changes the syntax.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 3:11 — "with God" vs "before God" vs "God himself"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "honored with-God" | Literal preposition |
| LOGOS | "honored before God" | Formal rendering of qodam |
| PNEUMA | "God himself loves and honors him" | Dynamic restructuring |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "beloved and honored before God." The preposition qodam means "before/in the presence of," which LOGOS renders correctly. PNEUMA restructures the sentence too freely.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 3:13 — "make known" vs "reveal" vs "reveal every secret"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "they make-known to him everything" | Literal hoda' |
| LOGOS | "they reveal to him all things" | Formal with "reveal" |
| PNEUMA | "they reveal every secret to him" | Dynamic addition of "secret" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "they reveal all things to him" (reordered). PNEUMA's "secret" is not in the text; EMET's "make-known" is acceptable but "reveal" better suits the context of heavenly disclosure.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 3:15 — "children of earth" vs "people of earth"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the children-of the-earth" | Literal beney ar'a |
| LOGOS | "the children of earth" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "the people of earth" | Dynamic rendering losing kinship language |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the children of earth." Preserves the parallel with "sons of heaven" in the previous line; PNEUMA's "people" loses the familial terminology.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements: 6*
*Resolution: LOGOS 5, EMET/LOGOS 1, EMET 0, PNEUMA 0, Compromise 0*
